prompt:
Extend this video in the same single, unbroken, continuous shot with absolutely no cuts, no dissolves and no change of shot: every frame follows smoothly from the previous one.
The camera keeps flying straight toward the tower at the same steady speed as at the end of the video, without slowing down, keeping the tower at the center of the frame, and keeps climbing gently until it is level with the main observation deck. As it climbs, it tilts down very slightly and gradually to keep the observation deck centered, and this tilt eases out again before the end, so at the end of these 8 seconds the camera is flying level and straight toward the deck. The tower grows smoothly and evenly larger, to about twice its size at the start of these 8 seconds, so the main observation deck with its bands of windows, the angled struts and the upper ring become clearly visible. The base buildings on the hilltop and the drop-tower ride pass below toward the bottom of the frame and the amusement park leaves the frame, while the dense city and the mountains behind the tower slide slowly downward with real depth parallax. The camera stays well away from the tower and never flies into it.
Bright, clear daylight with a clean blue sky and scattered white clouds; the light stays the same through the whole shot.
The tower keeps exactly the same design throughout: a red and white lattice antenna on top, a small cap, an upper observation ring, angled support struts and a large main observation deck with horizontal bands of windows. The observation deck has no external cranes, arms, gondolas, lifts or scaffolding. The tower, buildings, roads, rides and trees stay rigid and never appear, disappear or change shape. Stable level horizon.
Photorealistic aerial drone footage of a real place: natural, true-to-life trees with individual leaves and varied shapes, sizes and shades of green; real building facades with real windows, balconies and rooftop details; real thin steel structures, rails and supports on the amusement park rides. Natural, unsharpened detail with soft, realistic edges and natural contrast; no painterly, oil-painting, illustrated or cartoon look, no outline halos, no over-sharpening, no HDR look. Clear, clean air with good visibility. No text, no logos, no aircraft or birds in the frame.
